description: Strict zomeable orthographic n-cube generator-family report. Records marked new have no zero generator, so they are not inherited from the previous cube by appending a zero generator.

conventions.strict_orthographic_test: sum_i v_i v_i^T = c I_3 over Z[phi]
conventions.inherited: at least one generator is zero
conventions.reducible_split: no zero generator, but at least two generators are parallel
conventions.primitive: no zero generator and no parallel generator pair
